answer: Weight anchors to an external wallet, not a POA key. A key publishes one Solana or Base address predating the join 30 days, sharing no upstream transfer with another anchor, read off public graph. Glacier pricing charges age: under 30 days a wallet holds no weight and its escrow bond counts zero, so each clone parks a per-clone deposit monthly. A raven probe linking two anchors to one funder folds them behind one cluster boundary worth a single seal, and the karst swallows every 400 POA bond beneath, jointly slashed and burned. A hundred clones need a hundred aged wallets; one edge burns all.
